diagram.name: BRFN Digital Marketplace - i* SR Model

customProperties.Description: Strategic Rationale model for the Bristol Regional Food Network digital marketplace. Expanded actors: Producer and Marketplace Platform. Collapsed actors: Customer, Marketplace Administrator, Payment Service, Certification Verification Service, Notification Service and BRFN (Marketplace Operator). It contains the same 43 dependencies as the SD model, each linked to the internal element that needs or provides it, and covers Use Case 1 (product listing and inventory), Use Case 2 (multi-vendor checkout and payment) and Use Case 3 (food-safety incidents and traceability). Three tensions are shown with contribution links inside the Platform: Trace affected orders hurts Customer data privacy (traceability vs privacy), Suspend affected product hurts Fair treatment of producers (suspension vs fair handling), and Calculate 5% commission helps Marketplace revenue but hurts Fair treatment of producers (commission vs payout).
